title: hyprland keybind fix for workspaces
body: SUPER digit workspace binds broken after hyprland upgrade. Fix bindings.conf and source from hyprland.conf with reload.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
-bind = SUPER, 1, workspace, 1
+bind = SUPER, 1, workspace, 1, exact
@@ -20,3 +20,4 @@
+exec-once = hyprctl reload

title: Add Bluetooth battery widget to waybar
body: Completely new feature: show Bluetooth headset battery in waybar. Unrelated to prior groups.
